items.summary: The notes page now has a 'HumanBench' link home (header, BASE_URL), a 'Privacy and terms (opens in a new tab)' link to index.html#/privacy in the footer (own tab, so nothing typed is lost), and a first-in-page skip link 'Skip to copying your notes' that is off screen until focused and moves focus (by script too, for Safari) to a new tabindex=-1 group around the provider warning, anti-coercion, placement, 'What to look for' and the copy/download buttons. Focus lands on the warnings, not past them, and 'Copy the notes' is the next Tab stop (second if the destination is a coding-agent file, where Download comes first). Copy/download behaviour is unchanged. main's top padding went from 1.5rem to 0.5rem so the new header does not push the first screen down.

items.summary: SaveSettings: after 'Keep my settings' succeeds, focus moves (after tick) to the 'Download a save file with my settings' button that replaces it (not to the kept paragraph: the live region already announces 'now kept', and focusing the paragraph would make a screen reader read the same sentence twice). The 18+ checkbox gets aria-invalid="true" while its error shows (with the existing aria-describedby), in both the keep and the download-only form. A refused keep (no tick) leaves focus on the button.

items.summary: WherePicker: each preset radio is named by its short label (aria-labelledby on a label span) and described by the longer line (aria-describedby on the hint span); the hint stays inside the <label>, so a tap anywhere in the block still picks the radio. Ids come from $props.id() so they are unique per component.

The duplicate 'Your settings are now kept on this device.' line is no longer drawn (visually-hidden class once the state line says it) but the same element, testid keep-status, role=status text is still announced, because e2e/routes.ts:212 and e2e/session-save.spec.ts:148,578 match keep-status text word for word. reviewByMessage: `The notes you made in ${month} may need another look.` -> `The notes you made in ${monthName(month)} may need another look.` (monthName is already exported above it). Check that they still say what you want, and copy them again if you change anything.' and rename the test (drop 'on the stored month for now').

In 'says when the review-by month has passed' expect 'The notes you made in January 2026 may need another look. Check that they still say what you want, and copy them again if you change anything.' (visit(['F1'], '2026-01')).

Line 212: `const DARK = '@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)'` must also accept '@media screen and (prefers-color-scheme: dark)' (e.g. `const DARK = new Set([...both])` and `!DARK.has(t.media)` in the stray-token test at ~224). app.css, render.css, notes.css and ResultsTalk.svelte now use the screen-only form; the failing test is 'every colour token of src/ sits in a rule that a sheet above stands for, at the top level or under prefers-color-scheme: dark' (30 strays, all that one string). scripts/css-tokens.ts matches /prefers-color-scheme:\s*dark/ as a substring, so the SHEETS pairs themselves still resolve.
